prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless background material for a desktop web interface. Primary request: a quiet, seamless warm conservation paper texture, evenly lit and nearly flat, suitable for repeating behind readable UI. Scene/backdrop: close macro view of archival rag paper. Style/medium: scanned paper stock, subtle natural fibers and tiny flecks, no illustration. Composition/framing: square tile with uniform density and no edges, no vignette, no directional lighting. Lighting/mood: soft diffuse museum archive light. Color palette: warm ivory and muted parchment, close to #f2ead8, with very low contrast. Materials/textures: fine paper fibers, restrained grain, no stains. Text (verbatim): none. Constraints: must tile cleanly, keep all texture details below the level that interferes with text, no border, no symbols, no writing, no objects, no watermark. Avoid: gradients, geometric patterns, stripes, grids, noise-heavy grain, plastic, canvas, leather, dark shadows.
